in_hebrew.name: Marjy
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Marjy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Maria', which means 'bitter' or 'rebellious'. The suffix 'jy' is believed to mean 'jewel'. This name was often given to girls named after the Virgin Mary.
